en: Now, as you can tell from the last lecture,
this course will focus on GitHub Copilot and
Cursor and some ChatGPT usage or similar
AI chatbots.
This course will not cover services like
Replit, Bolt.new, v0, or other
popular AI services you might have heard
of. For example, Replit is a service that
tries to use AI agents to solve problems for
you.
The idea is that you don't have to write too
much code there, but that instead the AI
does it for you and then you essentially
just review and tweak it. And whilst this
might sound promising, in my experience,
these services aren't fully there yet,
especially once you start working on more
complex problems. At least I was never
really able to become more efficient with
them. And whilst that might change in the
future, it's therefore not the focus of this
course. Instead, the focus are
the main players, the tools that in my
experience give you the biggest efficiency
boost. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and as
mentioned, to some degree, ChatGPT. Because
those tools integrated into your editor, or
in case of Cursor, your editor being a tool
with lots of AI integrated into it,
these really are the tools that allow you to
use AI efficiently as a developer and to
write code faster and hopefully also better.
That's why that's the focus of this course.
If you are looking for those other tools,
this just isn't the course for you. That's
really important to understand. Well, and
with that, let's continue.
